lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's thirteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 13? Nope!

lines.text: Cover a two by six board with dominoes and L-shaped tiles.
lines.caption: Cover a 2×6 board with dominoes and L-shaped tiles.

lines.text: Pieces may be turned. How many ways?
lines.caption: Pieces may be turned. How many ways?

lines.text: Check the top-left square. A domino, or an L that starts a zigzag.
lines.caption: Check the top-left square. A domino, or an L that starts a zigzag.

lines.text: An L, lying dominoes, another L. Each zigzag has a mirror twin!
lines.caption: An L, lying dominoes, another L. Each zigzag has a mirror twin!

lines.text: Then fill a table: one, one, two, five, eleven, twenty-four.
lines.caption: Then fill a table: 1, 1, 2, 5, 11, 24.

lines.text: Length six gives fifty-three ways. That's Choice C!
lines.caption: Length 6 gives 53 ways. That's Choice C!

lines.text: Thirteen was the trap. It leaves out the L tiles.
lines.caption: 13 was the trap. It leaves out the L tiles.

lines.text: Did you get fifty-three? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 53? Tell me below!
